name: Russia–Ukraine
value: Kyiv hit by ballistic missiles 25–26 Nov
summary: Russian missiles hit a Kyiv shopping centre on 25 Nov, injuring 7; strikes kill 4 in Kharkiv and Sloviansk
state: Russia fired ballistic missiles at Kyiv late on 25 Nov, hitting a shopping centre and an industrial building in Desnianskyi district and injuring seven, Mayor Vitali Klitschko said (Kyiv Independent). Overnight to 26 Nov a drone killed two people in a Kharkiv apartment, and glide bombs and a drone killed two and injured 12 in Sloviansk on 25 Nov, regional officials said (Euromaidan Press). Sustained mass strikes since the 19–20 Nov barrage keep the Alert.
for_you: Travel to Ukraine is against FCDO advice. Energy and grain markets stay exposed to strikes on infrastructure.
rubric_hit: Sustained mass-casualty strikes since 19–20 Nov = Alert
